name: Castellnou de Bages (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with a yellow lion rampant armed and langued red, 7/9 of the height.
history: The official flag of Castellnou de Bages is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with a lion 7/9 of the height set equidistant from the edges; the arms it derives from were approved on 26 April 1989 (DOGC no. 1143 of 17 May 1989) and the flag was published in 2006.

features.role: claws and tongue of the lion
